title: 読書の秋
subject_en: Picture-book style scenes of autumn reading with original cute animal characters, soft textured colours, warm autumn palette, ONE scene per cell. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: ねこやくまが本を読む場面を、絵本風のやさしいタッチで描いた読書素材です。図書だよりや読書感想文の案内に使えます。
items: a cat reading a big book under a tree with falling leaves
a bear carrying a stack of books in a library
a rabbit reading in bed by a small lamp
an owl wearing glasses reading on a branch
a fox reading with a cup of tea and a scarf
a child reading on a park bench among ginkgo leaves
a mouse reading a tiny book on an acorn
a cozy bookshelf with books, a plant and a lamp
a tall stack of books with a bookmark and autumn leaves
animals reading together on a picnic blanket
autumn leaf bookmarks in a row
a squirrel reading by candlelight near a window with the moon
